changes.keys[1]: Tank: back toward the hatch; forward toward the glass; steer left and right.
changes.keys[2]: Open sea: swim forward or back, turn, or drag to steer.
changes.keys[3]: Rise or dive; sprint, then hold your speed for turbo and roadrunner.
changes.keys[4]: Double-tap to barrel-roll or kick; interact, switch view, toggle sound, or return to your checkpoint.
changes.crimson.backstory: Four counts of grand theft aqua. Stole a filter pump and drove it straight through a feeding frenzy. The net came back empty; the officer came back wet. Bounty: 4,711 shells.
changes.crimson.staerke: The getaway fish. Nobody outruns that tail.
changes.angel.backstory: The castle ornament vanished at midnight. It returned at dawn, minus the drawbridge and one very nervous crab. Bounty: 900 shells.
changes.angel.staerke: Turns corners the searchlights never knew existed.
changes.mabi.backstory: Gave the filter root access. Gave the searchlights insomnia. Replaced the feeding alarm with the professor's own snoring. Bounty: 0xFFFF shells.
changes.mabi.staerke: Searchlights take longer to recognize the suspect.
changes.gold.backstory: Nobody knows where Bullion got the gold. Not the reef, not the pirates, and certainly not the museum whose treasure chest is now missing. Bounty: 24,000 shells.
changes.gold.staerke: Every fourth shell is worth twice as much.
changes.neon.backstory: He glows in the dark. The crew uses him as a lookout anyway. After the thirty-ninth raid, the cops started following the glow. Bounty: 300 shells and a lampshade.
changes.clown.backstory: Sold one sunken treasure chest to three pirate captains. At the auction, all three arrived in the same boat. He sold them the boat. Bounty: 650 shells.
changes.puffer.backstory: Six inches long. Twelve after a disagreement. A vending machine tried to swallow his coins. The vending machine has never been found. Bounty: 2,000 shells.
changes.guppy.backstory: Smuggled 30,000 shells through a customs net sewn shut at both ends. Refuses to explain the third end. Bounty: 1,200 shells.
changes.sub.backstory: Captured the warden's feeding schedule, then sold the recording back to him. Also has footage of the professor talking to the sea mines. Bounty: 3,500 shells.
changes.leiter_achtung[1]: Psst. Don't look at the camera.
changes.leiter_achtung[2]: You there. The fish with an escape plan.
changes.leiter_bedienfeld[1]: Control panel. By the hatch. Go.
changes.leiter_bedienfeld[2]: Next to the hatch. Someone left the panel unlocked.
changes.leiter_bedienfeld[3]: Swim to the panel before they notice.
changes.leiter_code[2]: Four digits. The bottle knows them.
changes.leiter_hinweis[1]: Someone left perfume in a prison tank. Cologne, specifically.
changes.leiter_hinweis[2]: Read the number on the bottle.
changes.leiter_hinweis[3]: Cologne water. Four digits on the label.
changes.leiter_hinweis[4]: 4711. There. We both committed a crime.
changes.beam[1]: Searchlights. Stay out of the beam. I'll handle the footage.
changes.combo[1]: Keep the shells coming. Don't break the chain.
changes.caught[1]: They saw you. I can only loop so much footage.
changes.chest[1]: I left you something. The owner hasn't noticed.
changes.hook[1]: Bait on a line. That's not a restaurant.
changes.flasche[1]: 4711. Keep the bottle. Lose the witnesses.
changes.truebe2[1]: That cloud isn't plankton. The filter stopped working.
changes.truebe3[1]: The water's turning. Get to the hatch. Now.
changes.zuSpaet[1]: Tank's gone. I warned you about the water.
changes.uboot[1]: An unattended submarine. You know what to do.
changes.augen[1]: Those eyes aren't decorations. Don't meet their stare.
changes.augenAlarm[1]: They've locked on. Break eye contact and move.
changes.augenGriff[1]: They pulled you in. I still have a way out.
changes.codeRight[1]: That's it. Hold on to your fins.
changes.hooked[1]: Line cut. Do not ask what I used.
changes.mine[1]: Old mines. New detonators. Keep your distance.
changes.puffer[1]: Puffer ahead. If it inflates, get clear.
changes.wirbel[1]: Current's reversing. Someone opened a drain.
changes.wirbelRaus[1]: Out of the spin. Count your fins.
changes.level3[1]: More lights. Follow the current between them.
changes.tunnel[1]: The tunnel lights are waking up. Swim.
changes.finale[1]: You made it. Someone is breathing on my channel.
changes.time[1]: Guards switch in a minute. Move before they do.
changes.canyon[1]: Stay low. The beam loses you in the deep.
changes.shark[1]: Hold still. That shark was trained on movement.
changes.eaten[1]: I'm still receiving your signal. From inside the shark.
changes.cells[1]: Red cells. Oxygen carriers. And you're riding one.
changes.hintTank: Back right. Round hatch. The bolts look loose.
changes.hintTankTouch: Back right. Round hatch. The bolts look loose.
changes.hintDoor: Keep pushing. Those bolts are giving way ({n}/{m}).
changes.hintOpen: Hatch open. Through it before anyone looks.
changes.hintPipe: Through the pipe. Follow the light.
changes.hintSea: Follow sonar to the next ring.
changes.hintSeaTouch: Follow sonar to the next ring.
changes.lead: Tank Four has a hatch nobody admits building. Force it open, ride the pipe into the sea, follow the sonar rings and stay out of the searchlights. The professor wants his fish back.
changes.loadTank: Lowering the evidence into Tank Four …
changes.rebuilt: The relic is standing again. Nobody saw a thing.
changes.livesOut: No hearts left. Back to the level start.
changes.gameOver.line: CASE CLOSED. The filter has no comment.
changes.back: Back to the last safe spot
changes.doppelNote: Shells count double. Get hit and the streak ends.
changes.lebenNote: One extra life. Try not to make a scene.
changes.sheet.title: Rap sheet
changes.sheet.perks.power3[2]: A fist shockwave. Unavailable until action buttons arrive.
changes.SCHRITT[2]: Adding the water they forgot to measure …
changes.SCHRITT[3]: Disabling the filter's sense of loyalty …
changes.TIPS[1]: Tip: Interact to grab, open, and occasionally steal.
changes.TIPS[2]: Tip: Sprint when the lights find you. Better yet, go before they do.
changes.TIPS[3]: Tip: Chests contain upgrades. Nobody has claimed ownership.
changes.TIPS[4]: Tip: Red searchlight beams are trouble. Stay dark.
changes.TIPS[5]: Tip: Swim through sonar rings to reach the next sector.
changes.intro 1.6 s: I'm Flexa. I count the living.
changes.intro 5.2 s: That hatch was welded shut. Twice.
changes.intro 6.5 s: Someone scratched a date into the glass.
changes.intro 7.8 s: The professor had the glass replaced.
changes.intro 10.4 s: Tank Four will be drained at six.
changes.intro 15.8 s: One thousand two hundred eighty-four days.
changes.intro 17.3 s: You never swam this close to the hatch.
changes.intro 25.7 s: I am not to mention Phase One.
changes.intro 30.9 s: He watches the footage in reverse.
changes.flexa.knapp.01: That was almost a spectacular autopsy.
changes.flexa.knapp.02: You dodged. The camera kept the embarrassing part.
changes.flexa.knapp.03: The net missed. I'll have to explain that to the net.
changes.flexa.knapp.04: Quick reflexes. Pity about the face.
changes.flexa.combo.01: All those shells. I should have checked your gills.
changes.flexa.combo.02: Another perfect chain. The searchlights are getting embarrassed.
changes.flexa.combo.03: You can keep the shells. Leave the fingerprints.
changes.flexa.combo.04: Collecting trophies from a crime scene. Charming.
changes.flexa.truhe.01: Who hid a chest under my kelp?
changes.flexa.truhe.02: An anonymous gift. How generous of the anonymous criminal.
changes.flexa.truhe.03: Turbo? I can hear your pulse from here.
changes.flexa.truhe.04: Invisible. Then why is the tank making that noise?
changes.flexa.licht.02: Smile. This recording goes straight to his bedroom.
changes.flexa.licht.03: That light is looking for you specifically.
changes.flexa.licht.04: Kelp is not a legal disguise.
changes.flexa.haken.01: An unattended snack. In a surveillance zone. Fascinating.
changes.flexa.haken.02: The bait has a hook. I assumed you'd notice.
changes.flexa.haken.03: Caught on camera and on a line. A collector's edition.
changes.flexa.mine.01: Congratulations. You located a working mine.
changes.flexa.mine.02: We found that mine in the professor's bathtub.
changes.flexa.mine.03: The explosion was very photogenic. You weren't.
changes.flexa.augen.01: Those eyes have watched every fish before you.
changes.flexa.augen.02: I told him they were too many. He requested eyelids.
changes.flexa.augen.03: Absorbed. I warned him about the pupils.
changes.flexa.hai.01: Specimen Seven is awake. Oh, excellent.
changes.flexa.hai.02: He was fed this morning. That has never stopped him.
changes.flexa.hai.03: Do not let him smell the sedative.
changes.flexa.tod.01: One heart gone. Still two opportunities to disappoint him.
changes.flexa.tod.02: Back again. You are making the footage difficult to edit.
changes.flexa.tod.03: Respawn confirmed. I distinctly remember you dying.
changes.flexa.tod.04: The professor says repetition proves the theory. He will not say which theory.
changes.flexa.over.01: Flushed. He insisted on keeping the recording.
changes.flexa.over.02: Game over. For the fish on that camera, at least.
changes.flexa.over.03: Your old tank is empty. He keeps pointing at it.
changes.flexa.level.01: Another sector gone. He's started counting backwards.
changes.flexa.level.02: You cleared that sector. I have no explanation prepared.
changes.flexa.level.03: The professor would like the next level removed.
changes.flexa.uboot.01: There is a fish in the submarine. There should not be a fish in the submarine.
changes.flexa.uboot.03: Do not surface near the cameras. I mean it.
changes.flexa.kapern.01: You changed fish. Who authorized the cast change?
changes.flexa.kapern.02: That fish had a name. Probably a different one now.
changes.flexa.kapern.03: New body. The cameras still know your face.
changes.flexa.leer.01: Still here? The water is developing opinions.
changes.flexa.leer.02: The professor has been waiting behind the glass. He forgot to blink.
changes.flexa.leer.03: Goldfish do remember things. He hates that discovery.
changes.flexa.leer.04: A thousand days in circles. And now you want a map.
changes.flexa.leer.05: I could open the hatch. The problem is what waits beyond it.
changes.flexa.leer.06: The water is getting darker. I can hear the filter breathing.
changes.flexa.leer.07: You were much easier to understand before you found the exit.
changes.falkenstein.flucht.01: Four bolts. I tightened them myself. The fourth one has my initials scratched off. Who has been in Tank Four?
changes.falkenstein.flucht.02: That escape tunnel was sealed after the previous trial. Previous trial? Oh, now you've made me say it.
changes.falkenstein.kelp.01: Those plants were grown in darkness. Why are they turning toward you? Don't you dare turn toward that fish.
changes.falkenstein.kelp.02: You ate three test samples. I know because the fourth is still screaming under the sand.
changes.falkenstein.riff.01: The mines were designed to recognize my pulse. They started detonating whenever I applauded. You see the difficulty.
changes.falkenstein.riff.02: You survived the reef? Then stop swimming in circles. The data keeps drawing a face. Mine, apparently.
changes.falkenstein.augen.01: Every eye in that field came from a different specimen. They were supposed to look outward. Why are they looking at me?
changes.falkenstein.augen.02: I never taught them to blink together. Whoever did that is still in the laboratory.
changes.falkenstein.hai.01: Number Seven has not eaten for an hour. That means it is either asleep or planning something. I dislike both.
changes.falkenstein.hai.02: Release Number Seven. If it remembers my name, cut the microphone.
changes.falkenstein.blut.01: You are in my bloodstream. I can feel you taking that corner. I can feel you laughing. Stop taking corners.
changes.falkenstein.blut.02: I gave those erythrocytes names. The large one is Beatrice. Whatever you do, do not tell her who I am.
changes.falkenstein.frei.01: Out sightseeing? I grew that coral from an organ nobody has identified yet. Please do not touch the pink parts.
changes.falkenstein.frei.02: Stop picking up the shells. Some of them are teeth. Some of the teeth are still alive.
changes.falkenstein.over.01: Back in the tank. Good. Why does the hatch remember you? It never did that for me.
changes.falkenstein.over.02: Tank Four secured. The cameras are still showing your escape. Where are they getting the pictures?
changes.falkenstein.ziel.01: Open sea. You think this is the end? I still have the specimen jar you hatched in.
changes.falkenstein.ziel.02: Human trials were scheduled for next week. You seem to have started one from the inside.
changes.modeNote.chill: The beams are slow. The sea is almost peaceful.
changes.modeNote.gangster: Harder pursuit. Less time to disappear.
changes.modeLives.gangster: Three lives. The cameras get all three.
changes.god.title: Behind the glass
